articles.title: Syria live: Ceasefire in Aleppo after at least 22 killed since Tuesday
articles.summary: Syria's Defence Ministry has declared a ceasefire in Aleppo neighbourhoods following intense fighting since Tuesday. This critical announcement aims to halt renewed hostilities that tragically claimed 22 lives. For SSB aspirants, this highlights ongoing geopolitical complexities and the crucial role of defence establishments in managing and de-escalating conflicts in war-torn regions like Syria.

articles.title: Should Strategic Ambiguity Be Saved?
articles.summary: Taiwan has begun distributing a new, cartoon-filled civil defense handbook to its citizens, detailing emergency preparedness like kit assembly and relief station procedures. This initiative underscores Taiwan's proactive approach to national resilience and citizen readiness. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the critical importance of civil defence strategies and public preparedness in safeguarding national security amidst geopolitical complexities and potential crisis scenarios.
